product_family: RelativityOne - AI-powered legal data platform for e-discovery, case management, and data breach response with integrated generative AI suite (aiR for Review, aiR for Privilege, aiR for Case Strategy, aiR for Data Breach Response, aiR Assist conversational AI).

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Relativity ODA LLC and its subsidiary, Relativity Global LLC comply with the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (EU-U.S. DPF), the UK Extension to the EU-U.S. DPF, and the Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework

privacy.dpa_note: Relativity uses Standard Contractual Clauses for international data transfers and is positioned as a data processor with respect to customer data. No separate DPA document publicly linked, but data processing agreements are standard in enterprise contracts.
privacy.ai_training_note: Data submitted for processing by Azure OpenAI is not retained beyond your organization's instance, nor is it used to train any other generative AI models from Relativity, Microsoft, or any other third party. This applies across all aiR products (aiR for Review, aiR for Privilege, aiR for Case Strategy, aiR for Data Breach Response).

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Standard HTTPS/TLS encryption; RelativityOne built on Azure which provides additional encryption mechanisms

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Customer data encrypted at rest on Azure infrastructure

security.name: Data Access Controls
security.value: Just-in-time access model; privileged access management solution; customer data access by Relativity extremely limited

security.name: Threat Monitoring
security.value: 24/7/365 monitoring by Relativity's in-house security team (Calder7); continuous monitoring and advanced threat detection

security.name: Incident Response
security.value: Real-time defect detection; incident response team available

security.name: Cloud Provider Security
security.value: Built on Microsoft Azure, which meets more than 90 international and industry-specific compliance standards

security.name: AI Model Security
security.value: Extensive peer review and validation of AI models before deployment; bias testing; opted out of Microsoft's abuse/harmful content monitoring to ensure no unauthorized access to raw inputs/outputs
